source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; accepted Avena taxon pages and individual author-qualified synonym records; 2006 World Grass Species Synonymy cited in POWO historical-concept note
accepted_hybrid: Avena × hybrida Peterm. (A. fatua × A. sativa)
accepted_infraspecific_boundary: Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana (Durieu) Nyman accepted under A. sterilis
synonym_and_rank_caution: Historical names with Avena fatua as parent binomial can resolve to A. sativa, A. sterilis, A. nuda or A. sterilis subsp. ludoviciana. Preserve full author/rank and original name; do not auto-collapse. A. sterilis Delile ex Boiss. pro syn. differs from accepted A. sterilis L.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — original source-labelled photos not independently vouchered to species or subspecies
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — Avena × hybrida accepted parent formula does not authenticate any gallery specimen
install_decision: Retain existing Avena fatua learner; no new card, species/gallery/lesson or Pages changes

decisions.subject: Avena fatua L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species in existing canonical learner
decisions.detail: Kew POWO/WCVP accepts Avena fatua L.; genus Avena, rank species. Canonical binomial matches.

decisions.subject: Avena sativa subsp. fatua (L.) Fiori
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic alias of Avena fatua, not A. sativa
decisions.detail: POWO lists subsp. fatua under accepted A. fatua.

decisions.subject: Avena sativa var. fatua (L.) Fiori
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic alias of Avena fatua
decisions.detail: Original placement under A. sativa does not change accepted destination.

decisions.subject: Avena sterilis subsp. fatua (L.) Bonnier & Layens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic alias of Avena fatua, not A. sterilis
decisions.detail: POWO lists this combination under A. fatua.

decisions.subject: Avena patens St.-Lag.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic synonym of Avena fatua; illegitimate superfluous name
decisions.detail: POWO labels nom. illeg. superfl.; do not treat as accepted.

decisions.subject: Avena pilosa Scop.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic synonym of Avena fatua; illegitimate superfluous name
decisions.detail: POWO labels nom. illeg. superfl.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua var. glabrata Peterm.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as heterotypic synonym of Avena fatua, not accepted variety
decisions.detail: POWO places var. glabrata under A. fatua; does not certify any photographed variety.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua var. intermedia (T.Lestib.) Lej. & Courtois
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as heterotypic synonym of Avena fatua
decisions.detail: POWO lists variety among heterotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua subsp. meridionalis Malzev
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as heterotypic synonym of Avena fatua
decisions.detail: POWO lists historical subspecies under A. fatua.

decisions.subject: Avena sterilis L. (1762), nom. cons.
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain separate accepted species; do not merge with Avena fatua
decisions.detail: POWO accepts both species and recognizes two A. sterilis subspecies.

decisions.subject: Avena sativa L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain separately accepted cultivated-oat species
decisions.detail: POWO accepts both A. sativa and A. fatua; hybridization does not synonymize them.

decisions.subject: Avena nuda L. (1756)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain separately accepted species from Avena fatua
decisions.detail: POWO accepts A. nuda; historic combinations under fatua do not merge it.

decisions.subject: Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana (Durieu) Nyman
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve accepted subspecies at rank under A. sterilis, not under A. fatua
decisions.detail: POWO accepts subsp. ludoviciana; no specimen-level assignment.

decisions.subject: Avena × hybrida Peterm. (1842)
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted hybrid A. fatua × A. sativa; no auto-merge with either parent
decisions.detail: POWO accepts hybrid with explicit parent formula.

decisions.subject: Avena barbata Pott ex Link
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve distinct accepted species, not a wild-oat synonym
decisions.detail: POWO separately accepts A. barbata.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua var. sativa (L.) Hausskn. → Avena fatua
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic parent-binomial mapping; accepted destination is Avena sativa
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly synonymizes historical variety under A. sativa.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua var. sterilis (L.) Bastard → Avena fatua
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic parent-binomial mapping; accepted destination is Avena sterilis L.
decisions.detail: POWO treats historical variety as homotypic synonym of A. sterilis.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua subsp. nuda (L.) Thell. → Avena fatua
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic parent-binomial mapping; accepted destination is Avena nuda
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly lists under A. nuda.

decisions.subject: Avena fatua var. trichophylla (K.Koch) Griseb. → Avena fatua
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic parent-binomial mapping; accepted destination is Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana
decisions.detail: POWO synonymizes historical variety under accepted A. sterilis subsp. ludoviciana.

decisions.subject: Avena sterilis Delile ex Boiss. (1884) treated as Avena sterilis L. (1762)
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject name-only equivalence without author and status; Delile ex Boiss. record is pro syn. under A. fatua
decisions.detail: POWO lists author-qualified A. sterilis Delile ex Boiss. as pro syn. in A. fatua synonym list while accepting A. sterilis L. separately.

decisions.subject: Canonical Avena fatua gallery specimens and source photographs
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not certify every individual photo as independently identified Avena fatua
decisions.detail: Existing card says photographs are source-labelled, with unvouchered exact species determination; morphology alone cannot authenticate all.

decisions.subject: Hybrid ancestry of any photographed wild or cultivated oat
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assign Avena × hybrida identity to individual photographs or feral populations without voucher/genetic evidence
decisions.detail: Published accepted hybrid parentage is taxon-level, not proof of photographed individual's ancestry.

decisions.subject: Avena ludoviciana var. glabrescens Durieu ex Godr. historical treatment conflict
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve POWO current synonym placement under Avena fatua and note older Grass Synonymy cited Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana; do not relabel a historical observation without original concept review
decisions.detail: POWO's name page gives A. fatua as current destination but its cited 2006 World Grass Species Synonymy authority used A. sterilis subsp. ludoviciana. Historical specimen-concept reconciliation remains unresolved.
